programs.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "MacSchappert"
programs.desc: What can Terry do with just a paperclip? Probably nothing, but Larry and Terry will test several scenes from MacGyver, including making an exploding pen, shooting a spear out of a telescope, and they will enlist the help of Andre Ellingson’s Special Effects team to see if they can turn a car muffler into a bazooka!

programs.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Hyperloop"
programs.desc: Virgin Hyperloop is a train that runs inside a steel tunnel. This revolutionary new vehicle floats along the track using magnetic levitation and glides at airline speeds.

programs.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "The Race to Space"
programs.desc: A new era of space, where small satellites no bigger than a showbox will be deployed not in one or twos, but in their thousands, referred to as satellite swarms.

programs.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Perpetual Power"
programs.desc: All over the world, engineers and scientists are racing to solve one key problem: how to safely and efficiently store electricity at a huge scale but at a low cost.

programs.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Timber Skyscraper"
programs.desc: This film explores the mind-blowing world of timber buildings for a more sustainable future.

programs.title: How Things Work S1 - "Skateboards, Vacuum Cleaners and ATMs"
programs.desc: Skateboard, vacuum cleaner, ATM, car jack, digital projector, and multi-tool... Using ultra realistic CGI animation, we explode everyday objects into their component parts, to reveal their secret workings.
